FullyHomomorphicEncryption/Statements.lean proves quotient-polynomial and tensor conversion theorems; CIRCT/DC/Lemmas.lean proves stream semantics facts; LLVMRiscV/PeepholeRefine.lean defines correctness-bearing rewrite structures.
The few zero-byte files are already excluded by FD-001 and import umbrellas are already classified by FD-016; the remaining 138 primary files contain unique formal content and should stay searchable.
summary: Retain the direct project subtrees: they contain substantive compiler-semantics, hardware, cryptography, and verified lowering developments with unique statements and interfaces.
